title: Word frequency
prompt: Implement `static Dictionary<string, int> WordCounts(IEnumerable<string> words)` — each distinct word (case-**insensitive**, store lowercased) mapped to its count. Null or empty input returns an empty dictionary.

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: Case folding means "B" and "b" are one word.

tests.name: edges
tests.hint: No input, no entries — and the stored keys must be lowercase so later lookups compose.
